baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative أخرجنا, the interior deixis فيها, and المؤمنين bind outward movement to an interior group characterized by ء م ن.
baseline_models.mechanism: Causative خروج carries those actually present inside across a boundary, while the security-and-trust branch of ء م ن makes that transfer protective rather than merely expulsive.

activation_trace.role: Passage to an exterior supplies the spatial transfer and makes causative extraction the core operation.
Actual occurrence and presence in time establish that the protected group was situated within the interior when removal occurred.
Settled security and trust supply the group's protected quality and turn outward transfer into deliverance.

changed_reading.before: A group is removed from a place.
changed_reading.after: Those securely present inside are caused to cross outward as a protected group.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أخرجنا and the partitive من المؤمنين permit the embedded believing subset to be both removed and made manifest.
baseline_models.mechanism: The disclosure branch of خ ر ج overlays spatial exit: extraction reveals which occupants carried settled assent, converting evacuation into visible differentiation.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something out of concealment supplies disclosure and makes the extraction expose a previously embedded subset.
Place and station derived from being supply the embedded location from which the subset becomes distinct.
Heart-settling assent supplies the criterion disclosed by the separation rather than treating المؤمنين as an unexplained label.

changed_reading.after: Evacuation simultaneously exposes a believing subset whose settled assent had been embedded among the occupants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The guests' entry and doubled peace establish an inward, secured threshold crossing; the focus reverses the vector by causing the secure occupants to cross outward.

activation_trace.role: Literal entry into an interior supplies the inward vector whose reversal organizes the focus extraction.
Repeated freedom from harm colors the threshold encounter with safety and prepares the protective force of the later exit.
Movement to the outside supplies the inverse threshold vector and completes the in-to-out choreography.
Security and trust identify the outward-moving group as protected rather than rejected.

structural_cues: The ordered window places دخلوا and doubled سلام before أخرجنا, creating a marked inward/outward and safety frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: entry, doubled peace, and later causative exit. Reader arrow: the inward visitors initiate a controlled threshold reversal that enables safe outward transfer. Alternative: the entry and greeting may only stage the encounter without defining the extraction.

changed_reading.after: Their extraction is the outward half of a threshold choreography: strangers enter under peace, then the secure occupants are escorted out.

context_deltas.mechanism: An inwardly lodged fear is answered by prohibition of fear and good news; the focus then gives the security branch of المؤمنين a material form by moving its bearers beyond danger.

activation_trace.role: Fear falling secretly into the self supplies the interior affective threat against which enacted security becomes legible.
Dread of an expected harm names both the fear and its verbal cancellation, creating the transition toward safety.
News that opens the face with joy supplies the positive turn from concealed fear to assured futurity.
Security and trust become an operative condition whose bearers receive concrete protection.
Crossing outside materializes the promised safety as relocation beyond the threatened interior.

structural_cues: 51:28 moves from inward fear to لا تخف and بشروه; 51:35 moves those named by ء م ن out of the endangered interior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: concealed fear, its verbal negation, good news, and later extraction of المؤمنين. Reader arrow: the extraction is the concrete performance of security rather than only transport. Alternative: ء م ن may function only as a group label, and the earlier fear belongs to a different participant.

changed_reading.before: Believers names the identity of those removed.
changed_reading.after: Belief's security dimension is enacted: the identity named by ء م ن becomes an experienced passage beyond expected harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: A dispatched mission names a culpable collective and marked material for limit-crossers; extraction discloses and removes the complementary class before target-specific judgment.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and setting in motion supply the commissioned procedure within which extraction becomes an ordered operation.
Culpability and offense supply the explicitly named target class against which the extracted class is differentiated.
A visible identifying mark supplies target specificity and turns the intervention into discrimination rather than indiscriminate impact.
Crossing a limit supplies the criterion attached to the marked target and sharpens the boundary between classes.
Bringing a hidden thing into view makes extraction the disclosure of the complementary non-target class.
Settled assent supplies the positive classification exposed and removed before the marked judgment proceeds.

structural_cues: The mission names criminals, specifies marked material for limit-crossers, and then selects من كان فيها من المؤمنين before the aftermath is counted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a dispatched mission, a culpable target, marked material, limit-crossers, and extraction. Reader arrow: extraction is the complementary sorting step that clears the non-target class. Alternative: the marking may qualify only the material, while the rescue remains procedurally independent.

changed_reading.before: Believers happen to be spared from a general catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: Extraction is a target-discrimination operation: it reveals and removes the non-target class before a marked judgment reaches its specified class.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate finding reduces the plural المؤمنين to a single household-scale enclave; extraction detaches that social unit from its surrounding place without dissolving its internal belonging.

activation_trace.role: Finding and striking upon something supply the post-extraction audit that determines the group's actual granularity.
Exception and exclusion narrow the result to a sole surviving social unit.
The members of a house supply a corporate household reading rather than counting only a physical building.
Wholeness and freedom from harm reinforce the household as the intact unit preserved through extraction.
Place and station supply the surrounding location from which the household's social identity is detached.

structural_cues: The same فيها links 51:35-36, while plural المؤمنين is immediately answered by singular بيت and plural المسلمين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated فيها, plural extracted persons, and the sole بيت of submitters found afterward. Reader arrow: بيت denotes the household as a corporate enclave whose membership survives relocation. Alternative: بيت may be only the physical structure used to count occupants.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified number of individual believers are removed.
changed_reading.after: A household-scale enclave is extracted: plural believers remain one social house even as they are detached from the condemned place.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated فيها binds two opposite operations at one location: living occupants go out, while a visible trace is deliberately left in. Extraction therefore redistributes evidence rather than merely emptying the place.

activation_trace.role: Leaving an effect after departure supplies the retained residue that complements the removal of living occupants.
A manifest sign supplies the visible form taken by what remains inside after extraction.
Passage to the outside supplies the mobile side of the paired operation.
Disclosure from concealment lets removal and retained sign function together as a two-part revelation.

structural_cues: Consecutive first-person plural clauses repeat فيها: أخرجنا marks movement out, then تركنا ... آية marks deliberate retention within.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: extraction from فيها followed by leaving a visible sign in فيها. Reader arrow: these are complementary allocations of evidence, persons mobile and trace stationary. Alternative: the sign may memorialize only the punishment and bear no deliberate relation to the extracted persons.

changed_reading.before: The place is emptied of believers.
changed_reading.after: The scene is repartitioned: living believers are carried out while a visible trace is retained inside, so exit and residue jointly disclose the event.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers birth imagery from the preceding announcement to a civic rescue and relies on the form-distant birth branch of ق ر ب. It remains anchored in causative خروج from an interior and is reinforced by adjacent youth and barrenness branches; downstream prose should call it a birth-like material analogy, not a lexical meaning of أخرجنا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أخرجنا من كان فيها provides emergence from an enclosing interior, while the immediately preceding sequence juxtaposes approaching birth, youthful life, and a barren condition.

activation_trace.role: The approach of birth supplies the exploratory transition from enclosed life toward emergence.
Youthful new life supplies the viable issue brought across the imagined birth threshold.
Barrenness of womb and offspring supplies the closed, unproductive enclosure against which emergence is surprising.
Passage from an interior to the outside anchors the analogy in the focus's actual movement.
Place and emplacement supply the containing interior from which the faithful life is figuratively delivered.

changed_reading.before: The faithful occupants are evacuated from a doomed settlement.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the extraction resembles a birth: viable faithful life emerges from an enclosure otherwise framed by barrenness and closure.

strongest_changes: Entry and doubled peace turn the focus into the outward phase of a protected threshold reversal.
The commissioned, marked-target sequence changes rescue into complementary sorting and disclosure.
The sole-house audit and retained sign divide the aftermath between a mobile household and a stationary trace.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's roots support both physical exit and disclosure, and both security and assent; the context activates these pairs simultaneously while also sustaining a contained birth-like emergence analogy.
remaining_uncertainties: The safety resonance between سلام, المسلمين, and المؤمنين may be functional, or the terms may remain distinct identity labels.
The birth-like reading may overextend the form-distant ق ر ب branch despite its strong positional and enclosure anchors.
The retained sign may complement the extracted persons deliberately, or it may only record the judgment.
